name: Neon World 3

runtime.layout: Measured runtime layout: bed uniformly scaled 1.20 and grouped with bedside table/candle and wall clock; TV corrected upright with 0.03 m clearance above the actual Drawer_Base mesh; vessel uniformly fitted to the console depth and placed in the free space beside the screen; small curtain header aligned to the existing window; static bounds and surface-contact checks run once at load
runtime.lighting: Warm-neutral key, subdued cyan/violet fill, one soft shadow-casting directional light; Unity baked lighting and reflection probes are not transferred

license.permission_note: User confirmed permission to use this asset in Aether.

warnings: Unity shaders, Udon scripts and VRC components were omitted; baked lighting and reflection probes are approximated with runtime lights.

Nine mesh-bearing nested prefabs were exported, including BoxBed and Alarm. The original six-piece bed is uniformly enlarged at runtime to a measured adult-scale sleeping length; headboard and pillows remain aligned toward the rear wall and the frame is seated on the wood floor.

The TV mesh orientation from the Unity conversion was nearly horizontal; the original model is corrected at runtime to a vertical wall-mounted screen with 0.03 m clearance above the actual console. The original vessel is uniformly scaled only enough to fit the available console depth and seated beside the TV without crossing the room envelope.
The imported LedCircle renders as a misplaced arc protruding above the wall clock and is hidden at runtime; the RoomLight fixture, Alarm case, and lightweight digital wall clock remain visible.
The separate Carpet mesh is hidden at runtime to reveal the continuous Wood042 floor beneath it.
The existing small wall-curtain asset is uniformly scaled and aligned to the existing window header; the full-height curtain and original materials remain.

The web scene provides one measured bed-approach interaction point and validates the direct approach against furniture bounds. Unity collider/spawn-point counts remain unverified; there is no complete room navmesh, sit/sleep pose, or movable door/drawer rig in the current source scene.
